title: Fungoida
author: CMDR Snickerdoodlez
description: Bioluminescent spores on dark loam. Leaf-shaped modules, mycelium between them, drifting spores, moss on a few corners, hyphae bars, its own fonts and icons. Blooms when you scan organics, wilts when the hull is hit, grows across the loading screen, and comes with a dark sound pack, Spore Drift. Extras need app 0.9.7+.
changes: Moss grows inside the module's corner (it hung off the edge before) with a tiny mushroom or two
Threads of mycelium run along the gaps between modules instead of tiny marks
A softer loam texture on the modules
Nothing of the theme shows over SETTINGS, the gallery or the editors any more (needs the app update)
